notes: Proof House application contracts for Sepolia, deployed in constructor dependency order from the accepted source. ArtStorage stores artwork; ArtHouse manages collections and sales; KeyProof verifies wrapped-key proofs; ArtifactsPiece is the locked implementation used by ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource for independent one-token ERC-721 contracts. ARTIFACTS has a fixed maximum supply of 256: 255 editions named ARTIFACTS #NNN and ARTIFACTS · THE SOURCE, minted only upon purchase and claim or auction settlement. IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) is an existing ERC-20 payment option for plain SVG collections. No fungible token or pool is deployed. ArtStorage, ArtHouse, ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource receive $owner explicitly and use two-step ownership without renunciation. BrokerPass offers at most 100 free ERC-721 passes, claimable with an ARTIFACTS piece or an identity.md seat (0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d), once per wallet and once per qualifying NFT. SubmissionReviews provides advisory reviews by seat and claimed piece holders, frozen when the curator decides a submission. No upgradeability, deployment ETH funding or post-deployment calls are included. The owner configures the application afterwards.
